svg.title: ⊢ λf. λx. case x of inl(y) → inl(f y) ‖ inr(z) → inr(z) : (a → b) → ((a ∨ c) → (b ∨ c))
svg.desc: 1. f : a → b, x : a ∨ c ⊢ x : a ∨ c, by ax. 2. f : a → b, x : a ∨ c, y : a ⊢ f : a → b, by ax. 3. f : a → b, x : a ∨ c, y : a ⊢ y : a, by ax. 4. f : a → b, x : a ∨ c, y : a ⊢ f y : b, by →E from 2 and 3. 5. f : a → b, x : a ∨ c, y : a ⊢ inl(f y) : b ∨ c, by ∨I₁ from 4. 6. f : a → b, x : a ∨ c, z : c ⊢ z : c, by ax. 7. f : a → b, x : a ∨ c, z : c ⊢ inr(z) : b ∨ c, by ∨I₂ from 6. 8. f : a → b, x : a ∨ c ⊢ case x of inl(y) → inl(f y) ‖ inr(z) → inr(z) : b ∨ c, by ∨E from 1, 5 and 7. 9. f : a → b ⊢ λx. case x of inl(y) → inl(f y) ‖ inr(z) → inr(z) : (a ∨ c) → (b ∨ c), by →I from 8. 10. ⊢ λf. λx. case x of inl(y) → inl(f y) ‖ inr(z) → inr(z) : (a → b) → ((a ∨ c) → (b ∨ c)), by →I from 9.
svg.text: ⊢ λf. λx. case x of inl(y) → inl(f y) ‖ inr(z) → inr(z) : (𝑎 → 𝑏) → ((𝑎 ∨ 𝑐) → (𝑏 ∨ 𝑐))
